description: This file defines the Manufacturer model class for the Admin part of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting manufacturer records, as well as managing related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Model class for managing manufacturer data in the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD operations for manufacturers, descriptions, store associations, layouts, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer record in the database, including related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Updates an existing manufacturer record and its related data such as descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Deletes a manufacturer and all related data, including descriptions, store links, layouts, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data of a specific manufacturer by ID.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalManufacturers
methods.description: Returns the total count of manufacturer records, optionally filtered.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a localized description record for a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records for a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes description records for all manufacturers in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a manufacturer with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all manufacturer associations with a specific store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches store IDs associated with a manufacturer.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a manufacturer with a layout for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Removes all manufacturer associations with a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many manufacturers are associated with a specific layout.
